title: Lampu Peta dan Bisikan Digital
theme: Mengeksplorasi rasa sepi dan adaptasi manusia terhadap teknologi yang semakin menyerupai koneksi pribadi, memicu refleksi tentang makna hubungan sejati.

cover.prompt: A cinematic photograph capturing an elevated concrete pathway on a high floor of a majestic, futuristic cityscape at dusk. A solitary figure, seen as a gentle silhouette, traverses the pathway, their presence subtly mirrored on expansive glass walls. The city, a panorama of vibrant, dynamic digital advertisements, bathes the scene in a spectrum of soft, reflective neon colors. Towering skyscrapers ascend into the tranquil sky, creating a sense of immense scale and quiet grandeur. Composition uses rule of thirds with a shallow depth of field, emphasizing the immediate walkway and the atmospheric reflections. The overall mood is one of futuristic energy blended with peaceful solitude.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, vibrant city glow, futuristic color palette

meta.plan_summary: Seorang freelancer di kota futuristik yang sepi menemukan asisten AI-nya mulai menampilkan emosi melankolis, memicu refleksi mendalam tentang kesendirian manusia dan esensi koneksi di era digital.
meta.target_emotion: Reflective melancholy, a sense of poignant solitude mixed with wonder about technological evolution.
